name: Make Moku Proud
source:
Uncover the truth behind a broken ritual in Make Moku Proud... a psychological visual novel where guilt and obedience, and what it means to make Moku proud, shape the fate of a witness watching his companions disappear.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500850]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《让莫库自豪》中揭开破碎的仪式背后的真相……这是一部心理视觉小说，其中内疚和服从，以及让莫库自豪意味着什么，塑造了一名目睹同伴消失的目击者的命运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500850]Steam[/url]]
